headline: Stock market: sellers pick up the pace - plunge in banks, Viohalco, PPC and Jumbo
summary: Greek shares fell further as sellers picked up pace, with steep declines in bank stocks and in Viohalco, PPC and Jumbo. Brent crude was reported above $100 a barrel.
why: The Athens Stock Exchange is Greece's main equity market, and its banks and large industrial and utility companies carry significant weight in the national benchmark. Oil prices and government bond yields shape the outlook for Greek equities.
why_moved: Sellers gained pace on the Athens exchange, with bank stocks and several large companies falling sharply. The report cites Brent crude above $100 a barrel and government bond yields as the backdrop.
